item.title: Review: Second China-built large cruise ship makes maiden commercial voyage
item.description: China’s second domestically built large cruise ship, Adora Flora City, embarked on its maiden voyage on Sunday, marking a new step in the country’s efforts to expand cruise tourism and boost consumption.
